verdicts.explanation: The /404 URL is the site's own not-found page; its near-empty body is expected for an error page, so its thin content costs nothing as a defect here.
The homepage states the brand name only in meta tags and carries no JSON-LD at all, so nothing machine-readable anchors 'Supercell' to a checkable external identity.

brawlstars-gift, clashofclans-gift, clashroyale-gift and hayday-gift render with no title element, and their extracted text is only the page's skip-link, confirming these pages produced no distinguishing content.

Zoom is disabled only on the three translated regional variants of the Clash of Clans gift-store page, not on the site's primary pages, which is the profile of a duplicate template restriction rather than a site-wide failure.

site_specific: Have the Next.js gift-page templates (clashofclans-gift, brawlstars-gift, clashroyale-gift, hayday-gift) server-render or statically generate the promo copy instead of leaving it to client-side hydration.
Confirm the fix by fetching the URL without executing JavaScript and checking that more than the skip-link text is present in the HTML.
Add a unique title tag (for example 'Brawl Stars Gifts and Store Specials times Supercell') to the brawlstars-gift, clashofclans-gift, clashroyale-gift and hayday-gift templates.
Reuse the pattern already used on the localized gift pages, which do carry titles such as 'Clash of Clans freebies and Store Specials'.

fixes.quote: Makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Squad Busters and mo.co.
site_specific: Add an Organization JSON-LD block to the homepage naming Supercell as the maker of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, Squad Busters and mo.co.
Include sameAs links to the company's own verified social and reference profiles so assistants can disambiguate the brand.

fixes.quote: Clash of Clans freebies and Store Specials
site_specific: Remove user-scalable=no and the maximum-scale restriction from the viewport meta tag on the translated Clash of Clans gift-store templates.
Verify on Android Chrome that pinch-zoom works on the fixed page.

fixes.quote: Sorry, but the page or file you were trying to access does not exist.
site_specific: Configure the /404 route to return an HTTP 404 status code instead of 200 while still serving the same 'page or file you were trying to access does not exist' message.
Re-crawl the URL and confirm the response status is 404, not 200.
